name: Bun tom Chau Truc
summary: Shrimp noodles from Châu Trúc, on the Trà Ổ lagoon. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says the shrimp is pounded live from that lagoon and stirred into boiling noodle water.
origin: Thôn Châu Trúc, xã Mỹ Châu, huyện Phù Mỹ.
howToEat: The bowl is the pounded shrimp, a little seasoning and fish sauce, the boiling noodle water, then the noodles, scallion, coriander, and pepper. A grilled rice cracker is served with it.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Châu Trúc, Phù Mỹ. Not a Quy Nhon street.
seoTitle: Bun tom Chau Truc — shrimp noodles in Phu My
seoDescription: Bún tôm Châu Trúc is pounded lagoon shrimp in boiling noodle water, in Phù Mỹ. The provincial portal names no Quy Nhon street. A price is Check on arrival.
